context_metadata.selection: ASCII-sorted five existing mechanism test tasks; first four parent IDs per task; prefer saved cut005, otherwise earliest saved snapshot. All selected rows have cut005. No use of score or success to select.
context_metadata.scope: Saved real observation replay for inference timing only; no new collection or closed-loop performance evaluation

Q_metadata.training: random initialization for timing only, zero optimizer updates
Q_metadata.device: cpu per current deployment; confirm final measurement scope in root

latency_wall_source: recorded outer wall_seconds only; no sum/max reconstruction
partial_worker_policy: valid recorded nonwarmup samples retained; worker statuses and missing coverage disclosed
throughput: per worker: sum(count(end_s<=duration_seconds))/sum(duration_seconds); never sum GPUs into one GPU
service_deadline_population: valid completed tasks released inside window, including completions drained after window
